title: 第236章 鬼潮降临第235章 为何不问
content_zh:
鬼怪的真相，终究还是被世人所知。
也正如他预料的那样，这件事一旦被世人知晓，这些愚昧的百姓，根本不会理解。
他们哪里懂得，鬼怪的存在，对尸蛮国而言有多么重要。
一个鬼怪便代表着一颗鬼丹，代表着修行资源。
若是没有鬼怪，尸蛮国哪里来那么多资源，供应给修行者？
没有那么多修行者，如何守土安疆，保民安乐？如何抵御巫尸国的侵略？
身为尸蛮国人，怎能只看到自己？
颜守卿一退再退，甚至退回了高空，退到了红月之内。
他隔着月光，望着镜海翻腾巨浪，望着海上缓步而行的少年，望着愤慨的燕飞龙，望着那滴滴海水……他忽然笑了！
颜守卿以手遮脸，癫狂的大笑起来。
错了，一切都错了。
不是说他今夜来错了，而是他在对待姜峰的态度上错了。
他不该抱着那一丝幻想，不该觉得姿态放低，送上一些鬼丹，便能取回剩下的鬼丹，便能大事化小，将事情遮掩过去。
任何一位神级强者，只要见过鬼嘲峡谷里那个鬼神，便都知晓那鬼神实力并不高，他这位尸蛮国师完全有能力将其灭杀。
所谓鬼神是杀不死，只是他蛊惑民众的一套说辞。
但这套说辞，是骗不过神级强者的。
故而，他才会出现，试探姜峰一行人的态度，也存着取回鬼丹的想法。
但是现在，事情似乎搞砸了。
不，是已经砸了。
但是没关系。

被百姓知道又如何？
他不是没想过有这么一天，他不是没预料过，会被人揭穿此事。
他也当然明白，当百姓知道鬼怪的来历后，会是怎样的情绪，会是怎样的痛苦。
但是，人往往因为无能而愤怒，因清醒而痛苦。
既然如此，那就让他们永远沉眠吧。
沉眠之后，将不会再有愤怒，不会再有痛苦。
世界会安静一段时间。
然后。
再次重生，回到以前的局面。
颜守卿退到红月之内，身上散发出耀眼的红光，那是刺眼的血光。
一丝丝血气遽然顺着浑身上下的毛孔溢散开来，放眼望去，仿若有无数细小的绒毛，从颜守卿的身上蔓延开来，使得这位俊美无涛的尸蛮国师，透着一种妖异的美感。
他的脸色变得愈发雪白，像是失去了大量的鲜血，变成了一尊拥有意识的尸体。
而血气蔓延至虚空，渐渐与红月相融。
红的发亮的血月，好似反被血气所遮掩，变得晦暗下来。
可下一刻。
铮——！！！
悬挂高空的红月，光芒倏然变亮，如同一只巨大的眼眸，掀开了眼睑，露出了眼瞳。
密密麻麻的血气，如同眼睛充了血，泛起了无数的血丝，尽显狰狞。
月光犹如眸光，俯瞰万里疆域。
“知道了又如何？这个世界，从来不需要关心弱者的声音。”

颜守卿将整个人都融入了红月，那一丝丝血气，犹如一根根细线，将他与红月连接在一处，亦如操控木偶的丝线。
他以红月为道途，修尸鬼之道，旨在操控众生，以万灵为尸鬼，托举着他登顶至高。
“既然都不服管教，那就索性关起门来……一个不留！！！”
content_en:
The truth about the ghosts is finally known to the world.
Just as he expected, once this matter became known to the world, these ignorant people would not understand it at all.
How do they understand how important the existence of ghosts is to the Corpse Barbarian Kingdom?
A ghost represents a ghost elixir and a resource for cultivation.
If there were no ghosts and monsters, where would the Corpse Man Country come from with so many resources to provide for practitioners?
Without so many practitioners, how can we protect our land and protect the people's well-being? How to resist the invasion of the Witch Corpse Kingdom?
As a corpse barbarian, how could he only see himself?
Yan Shouqing retreated again and again, even retreating to high altitude and within the red moon.
Across the moonlight, he looked at the huge waves rolling in the Sea of ​​Mirrors, at the young man walking slowly on the sea, at the indignant Yan Feilong, at the drops of sea water... He suddenly smiled!
Yan Shouqing covered his face with his hands and laughed maniacally.
Wrong, everything is wrong.
It's not that he came here tonight wrong, but that his attitude towards Jiang Feng was wrong.
He shouldn't hold on to the slightest illusion, shouldn't think that if he lowers his attitude and gives some ghost pills, he can get back the remaining ghost pills, and then he can reduce the big problem to a small one and cover up the matter.
Any god-level powerhouse who has seen the ghost and god in Guimo Canyon will know that the ghost and god is not very powerful, and he, the corpse barbarian master, is fully capable of killing him.
The so-called ghosts and gods cannot be killed is just a rhetoric he used to confuse the people.
But this kind of rhetoric cannot deceive a god-level powerhouse.
That's why he showed up to test the attitude of Jiang Feng and his party, with the idea of ​​retrieving the ghost pill.
But now, things seem to be messed up.
No, it has been smashed.
But it doesn't matter.
So what if the people know about it?
It's not that he didn't expect that one day, it's not that he didn't expect that someone would expose this matter.
Of course he also understood the emotions and pain the people would feel when they knew the origins of the ghosts.
However, people are often angry because of their incompetence and painful because of their sobriety.
In this case, let them sleep forever.
After sleeping, there will be no more anger and no more pain.
The world will be quiet for a while.
Then.
Reborn again, back to the previous situation.
Yan Shouqing retreated into the red moon, and his body emitted a dazzling red light, which was a dazzling blood light.
A trace of blood suddenly spread out from the pores all over his body. Looking at it, it looked like there were countless tiny fluffs spreading from Yan Shouqing's body, giving this handsome and graceless corpse master a strange beauty.
His face became whiter and whiter, as if he had lost a lot of blood and turned into a conscious corpse.
The blood energy spread into the void and gradually merged with the red moon.
The red and shiny blood moon seemed to be covered by blood and became dark.
But the next moment.
Zheng——! ! !
The red moon hanging high in the sky suddenly brightened, like a huge eye, opening its eyelids to reveal its pupils.
The dense blood was like eyes filled with blood, with countless bloodshot eyes, showing a ferocious look.
The moonlight is like eyes, overlooking thousands of miles of territory.
"So what if you know? This world never needs to care about the voices of the weak."
Yan Shouqing integrated his whole body into the red moon. The traces of blood were like thin threads, connecting him to the red moon, like the threads controlling a puppet.
He used the red moon as his path to cultivate the way of the ghoul, aiming to control all living beings, and used all spirits as the ghoul to lift him up to the top.
“Since you don’t want to be disciplined, then just close the door and leave no one behind!!!”
